title: ArcticDB library `universe` — column/dtype/index contract
description: Pinned CONSUMER copy, owned by crucible-executor (alpha-engine-config-I10796 / data_collection_plan_260914.md P-27, which also pins a copy in crucible for v2's data.daily under the same source library). Producer: nousergon-data ArcticDB store + builders (store/arctic_store.py, builders/daily_append.py) writing s3://alpha-engine-research/arcticdb/, library `universe`. Not a per-S3-object JSON Schema — this documents the per-symbol frame shape ArcticDB serves, matching data_collection_plan_260914.md §4.1's 'column/dtype/index contract, pinned in crucible' pattern extended to crucible-executor as the trader's own pin. Reader: executor/price_cache.py (`_open_universe_library` -> `nousergon_lib.arcticdb.open_universe_lib`, `load_price_histories`, `load_atr_14_pct`) and executor/signal_reader.py (`filter_buy_candidates_to_universe` via `universe_lib.list_symbols()`). No producer-side contracts/ copy of this shape exists yet in nousergon-data as of 2026-09-14 (data_collection_plan_260914.md §3 lists it as 'contracts/arctic_universe.schema.json (target)') — this pin is sourced directly from the live read paths in this repo and must be reconciled against the producer's own file, and crucible's pinned copy, once P-07 lands.

atr_14_pct.staleness_contract: most-recent row must be within 1 trading day of reference_date, or load_atr_14_pct hard-fails (executor.price_cache._ATR_MAX_STALENESS_TRADING_DAYS)

membership.list_symbols: universe_lib.list_symbols() -- read by executor/signal_reader.py::filter_buy_candidates_to_universe as the ArcticDB-side membership check on the morning planner's buy_candidates
membership.excludes: SPY/VIX/VIX3M/TNX/IRX/GLD/USO/XL*-sector-ETFs route to the separate `macro` library (Close-only), not `universe` -- see executor/price_cache.py::_MACRO_SYMBOLS

hard_fail_on: any requested ticker missing the atr_14_pct column (load_atr_14_pct)
any requested ticker's most-recent row older than 1 trading day (load_atr_14_pct)
degrade_on: individual ticker read errors in load_price_histories are surfaced as a RuntimeError naming the failed tickers (not silently dropped)
an empty frame for a ticker is omitted with an INFO log, not a hard fail (load_price_histories)
